easy.def: Ready for you to use or get.
examples: Is this seat available?
Cookies are available at the table.
The book is available at the library.

more.def: Able to be used, bought or had, because it is free and ready.
examples: Tickets are available at the front door.
Is the teacher available to talk now?
The library has many books available for you to borrow.
We live on Park Avenue.
The avenue is busy.
Trees line the avenue.

more.def: A wide street, often with trees or buildings on either side.
examples: We walked down the avenue to the park.
Tall trees lined the avenue.
The parade went down the main avenue.

easy.def: Normal, not big and not small.
examples: He is of average height for his age.
It was an average day at home.
My dog is an average size.

more.def: Usual or ordinary; in the middle, not very high or very low.
examples: An average school day lasts about six hours.
The average bus ride to school takes fifteen minutes.
This winter was colder than an average winter.
Avoid the puddle.
I avoid the hot stove.
We avoided the crowd.
Avoid the puddle in the road.
I avoided the busy street.
He avoided the hot stove.
